title: From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds

abstractEnglish: We show how information about partial permutations controls full permutation laws. Let n tend to infinity through multiples of eight. If the images of a uniformly chosen $`7n/8`$ labels approach the uniform injection law in average total variation, and the sign mean tends to zero, then the product of two independent permutations with the given law converges to uniform on Sn.
